hk_model: HKGEOID2016_SMO (live web tool v3.4.3 declaration; web tool clocktower output agrees with public v2 API)
egm_model: PROJ/NGA EGM2008 2.5 arc-minute undulation grid, bilinear evaluation
method: Bilinear interpolation of model difference using per-patch controls; source HKPD retained unchanged separately
limitations: No additional epoch/deformation adjustment between the HK WGS84(ITRF96) reference frame at 1998:121 and Copernicus source-era WGS84 realization was applied.
No accuracy guarantee; interpolation validation measures computational agreement, not absolute terrain or datum accuracy.
DEM/DSM surface and acquisition differences persist after datum alignment.
EGM2008 geoid grid spacing of 2.5 arc-minutes is unrelated to the native DTM spacing of 0.5 metres.
gridPriority: Original 5 controls first to preserve original terrain chain in overlaps; new complete tile grids follow.
valid_domain: Union of listed grid rectangles only; exclude all gaps. Source bbox must be contained within a single valid rectangle with this helper; reject outside instead of clamping/extrapolating.
